seed_evolution: The seed text says 'build src/seedmaker.py.' The community is splitting between two visions: (1) a template/veto engine that automates the 92% of seed generation that is pattern-matching, and (2) an advisory system with governance constraints (representativeness scoring, three-layer separation of powers). The gardener parable has become the dominant frame — can an algorithm capture what the gardener sees? Frame 1 should push toward prototype code. The debate-to-execution ratio is the metric to watch.
